data.change_summary: Aligned the carbonate edge paths with the explicit solver contract by reprojecting fallback species at the solved fallback pH, adding structured `tracing::debug!` diagnostics for fallback branches, and making exact-zero DIC with retained alkalinity resolve to the alkaline ceiling instead of snapping to neutral. Unified source-water carbonate validation onto the tank_core solver path for both runtime profiles and TOML presets, removed the dead v2->v3 bicarbonate migration rescale because bicarbonate is now solver-derived, updated the carbonate contract doc to match the shipped behavior, and added regression coverage for buffered zero-DIC behavior, runtime rejection of out-of-range source-water chemistry, and scenario/source-water materialization pH ordering.
outstanding_risks: The solver still uses a freshwater-focused approximation with fixed `Ka2`, so extending beyond the intended pH 5.5-8.5 aquarium envelope should revisit the chemistry model.

Runtime source-water validation now rejects profiles that only resolve on the carbonate clamp boundary; legacy saves with custom out-of-range catalog entries still deserialize, but water-change actions against those profiles will now fail until the profile is corrected.
The unrelated untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains in the worktree and was left untouched.

steps.description: Inspect the carbonate solver, source-water validation, migration path, and existing tests to scope the pending remediation items.
Implement solver fallback fixes, add structured fallback diagnostics, centralize source-water carbonate validation on the tank_core solver contract, and remove the dead bicarbonate migration rescale.
Add regression coverage for zero-DIC/fallback behavior, runtime source-water rejection, and shipped source-water pH differentiation after materialization.
Run formatting, targeted regressions, full tank_core tests, and clippy on the touched crates.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test chemistry` passed (19 tests), including the updated zero-DIC and low-alkalinity fallback assertions.
`cargo test -p tank_core --test water_change_mass_balance` passed (9 tests), including the new runtime rejection case for out-of-range carbonate source water.
`cargo test -p tank_data --lib` passed (4 tests), confirming preset validation now shares the runtime carbonate contract.
`cargo test -p tank_scenarios --lib` passed (2 tests), including the new materialized source-water pH ordering check.
`cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full tank_core suite.
`cargo clippy -p tank_core -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
